title: Colour by colony, or by species, as the lab's default
question: Two ways to colour the same frame. A: each placement gesture is a colour (two ant colonies differ, beetles a third). B: each species is a colour (all ants one colour, beetles another). The population graph groups the same way as the colour. Which should the lab open on? Both stay available on the toggle.
context_md: Same frame as the card above. meta: 83 animals alive, 2 ant colonies + 6 beetles. With colony rivalry ON (parameters page, ANTS, off by default) the two ant colonies become strangers to each other and a hungry ant eats one from the other colony.
